questions.excerpt: Article342లో Scheduled Tribe recognition state/UT-specific. Scheduled Areas are specified territories; Scheduled Tribe community categoryతో identical కాదు. Individual legal eligibility నిర్ణయానికి current notifications/rules అవసరం; textbook association alone certificate proof కాదు.

questions.question_en: Which planning approach best recognises livelihood diversity?
questions.question_te: Livelihood diversityను గుర్తించే planning?
options: Consult communities and assess varied contemporary work and service needs
Infer household income from community name
Assume all members have one unchanging occupation
Ignore language barriers
option_explanations: Contemporary evidence and participation avoid stereotypes.
Name does not prove income.
Livelihoods vary/change.
Language affects access.

questions.excerpt: Forest livelihoods cultivation,wage work,forest produce,pastoralism,crafts,services వంటి mixed activities ఉండవచ్చు. Land tenure,forest access,health,education,language access,transport,vulnerability to displacement కలిసి planningలో చూడాలి. Community consultation and culturally accessible services అవసరం; isolationను timeless natural traitగా లేదా loss of language inevitableగా present చేయవద్దు.
